en.bdb: Many are perfume sellers and many dyers who use colors to make many designs (rangolis).

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਮੇਵੇਦਾਰ ਹਨਿ ਹੁਡਕ ਹੁਡਕੀਏ ਲੋਲਣਿ ਲੋਲੀ।
verses.translit_en: kitaRe mevedhaar han huddak huddake'ee lolan lolee|

en.bdb: Many are servants working on contract and many are frolicsome prostitutes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਿਜਮਤਿਗਾਰ ਖਵਾਸ ਲਖ ਗੋਲੰਦਾਜ ਤੋਪਕੀ ਤੋਲੀ।
verses.translit_en: khijamatigaar khavaas lakh gola(n)dhaaj topakee tolee|

en.bdb: Many are personal maidservants, bomb-throwers, cannoners and many are carriers of war material.
Many are revenue officers, superintending officers, policemen and estimators.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਕਿਰਸਾਣ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਅਤੋਲੀ।
verses.translit_en: ketaRiaa(n) kirasaan hoi kar kirasaanee atul atolee|

en.bdb: Many are farmers who weigh and take care of the agricultural crop and its allied works.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਸਤੌਫੀ ਬੂਤਾਤ ਲਖ ਮੀਰਸਾਮੇ ਬਖਸੀ ਲੈ ਕੋਲੀ।
verses.translit_en: musatauafee bootaat lakh meerasaame bakhasee lai kolee|

en.bdb: Millions are accountants, home secretaries, oath officers, finance ministers and tribal people who prepare bows and arrows.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਦੀਵਾਨ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਨਿ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਮੁਲਕ ਢੰਢੋਲੀ।
verses.translit_en: ketaRiaa(n) dheevaan hoi karan karoRee mulak dda(n)ddolee|

en.bdb: Many becoming custodians of property administer the country.
Many are there who have the accounts of invaluable jewels etc. and deposit them properly.
